**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
Review PR #331 (#210, release audit gate ordering) with brain's own methodologies → judgment-day dual blind review → fix the blocker underneath → name and attack the systemic pattern → roadmap it, ticket it, link it to the epic → resolve the merge fallout → promote #330.

**Final state: everything merged. Session closed at `da3145b` on `main`, working tree clean.**

## Instructions (owner preferences — apply unprompted)
- **Track AND link bidirectionally.** A child saying `Part of #313` is NOT enough — edit the epic body in the same pass. The owner caught me repeating the exact M8 rot.
- **Never bypass a human approval gate**, even with verbal authorization. `status:approved` is their keystroke. I refused to self-apply it and the owner approved #332/#335/#339/#317 himself each time.
- **Verify before agreeing.** Owner said an agent had started #317; verified no branch/PR/worktree existed and said so. (Later he approved it and assigned `csrinaldibot`.)
- Prefers being told plainly when a proposed action contradicts the repo's own governance — he chose the compliant path (memory commit into PR #338) over a direct commit to main when offered.

## Discoveries
- **THE PATTERN — "seam blindness"**: logic correct and well tested; failure at the seam where it meets something it doesn't control. FOUR instances in one session: #317 (`prReviews` drops `body`, `github.mjs:291`), #210/#331 (gate runs after the tag), #334 (`brain:ship` hardcodes nonexistent `kind:feature`, `brain-ship.mjs:94`), #340 (local `issueLink` at `issue-link.mjs:23` accepts `Part of #N` unconditionally while CI branches on base branch → `brain:check` greenlights PRs CI rejects). **TWO of the four were found by accident.** Four is a floor, not a total.
- **CORRECTED a wrong hypothesis by measuring**: "brain lacks negative tests" is FALSE — phase-order-check 15 failure assertions, actor-check 9, brain-audit 8, 1899 tests green. Gates ARE proven able to fail, only against inputs the tests themselves author.
- **The antidote already exists**: `vcs.contract.test.mjs` + recorded-vs-derived fixture provenance. Gap A = uncovered verbs (`prReviews` is the one verb the reviewer needs and the one unpinned). Gap B = mutating writes can't be recorded, so derived fixtures encode the author's assumption — fixture and code share the same wrong belief (#334).
- **#332 root cause**: `git-seam.mjs` `execFileSync` had no `maxBuffer` → 1 MiB default; `e5371dc`'s `--binary` diff is 3,964,248 bytes; ENOBUFS carries no git exit code → `-1` → `audit-uncomputable`.
- **#330 IS NOT A CONFLICT PROBLEM — the epic's description was wrong.** Hit live rebasing #338 after #333 merged. GitHub said `CONFLICTING`; git said **"Automatic merge went well"** with ZERO conflict markers. A clean auto-merge of append-only JSONL can drop/interleave records silently. Verified correct only by comparing `sync_id` SETS (main 1487 unique / branch 1490 / merged 1490, zero lost). Correct because someone checked by hand, not because tooling guarantees it.
- **89 duplicate `sync_id` entries** in `.memory/records/2026-07.jsonl`, pre-existing identically on both sides. `memory:share` re-exports already-exported observations. Bloat on exactly the file whose size caused #332. **A plain `merge=union` would NOT fix this — the driver must dedup by `sync_id`.** Needs its own ticket (not yet filed).
- Tooling gotchas: `gh pr edit` fails on this repo (projects-classic GraphQL deprecation) — use `gh api -X PATCH repos/{o}/{r}/pulls/{n} -F body=@file`. GitHub forbids `--request-changes` on your own PR. `mergeable` is computed async and reads stale right after a push — poll it. brain has NO issue-creation verb.
- **Ordering vs #328's race**: approve the issue FIRST, then edit the PR body; the edit re-triggers gates so they evaluate real state. Reverse order leaves a stuck red.

## Accomplished
- **PR #331** — REQUEST CHANGES posted (as a comment; GitHub blocks self-request-changes) with 12 findings confirmed by both blind judges, 0 contradictions, 6 CRITICAL. Includes a Tier 3 violation: ADR-0025 committed straight to `brain/project/decisions/` as `Accepted`, bypassing `brain-drafts/`, while the PR body claimed a `brain-drafts/` file absent from the diff.
- **#332 filed and fixed → PR #333 MERGED.** Strict TDD; red first (`got -1 (stderr: )` — the empty stderr was the second bug). 256 MiB explicit ceiling kept finite deliberately; ENOBUFS special-cased so the reason survives. `brain-audit v1.0.0..origin/main`: EXIT=2 uncomputable → EXIT=0.
- **PR #338 MERGED** — `docs/inbox/seam-contract-coverage-roadmap.md` + session memory. Resolved the #330 merge against main, verified by set comparison.
- **Issues filed**: #334 (ship label), #335 (M10 parent), #336 (P1 audit), #337 (P3 efficacy probe), #339 (doc), #340 (local/CI divergence).
- **EPIC #313 edited twice**: (1) M10 added, sequence → `M10(P0,P1,P3) → #210 → M2 → …`, "#210 is the first item" prose rewritten, recurring meta-defect recorded; (2) **#330 promoted to the front of the queue** with its wrong description struck through and corrected.
- **#330**: `priority:high` label created (none existed in this repo) and applied; evidence comment posted.
- Bidirectional links on #210, #317, #330, #334, #335, #336, #337.
- Handoff briefing written for the #317 agent — the load-bearing paragraph is that the `prReviews` fixture must be **recorded, not derived**.

## Next Steps
- **#330 is next** — front of the queue. Merge driver must dedup by `sync_id`, not plain union.
- **File the 89-duplicate `memory:share` ticket** (identified, not yet filed).
- **Decide #331**: reduce to its honest slice (the `auditBaseline` line) or close and rebuild under #210.
- **Approve** #334, #336, #337, #340 (all `status:needs-review`).
- **Answer M10 open question 1 BEFORE #336 runs**: milestone, or cross-cutting standard? Four instances, two accidental, argue hard for the standard. It changes how #336's children are ticketed.
- **#317**: approved, assigned `csrinaldibot`. Deliver the briefing minus its now-stale `status:approved` bullet.

## Relevant Files
- `brain/scripts/governance/postmerge/git-seam.mjs` — FIXED (#332, merged)
- `brain/scripts/vcs/providers/github.mjs:291` — `prReviews` drops `body` (#317, open)
- `brain/scripts/brain-ship.mjs:94` — hardcoded `kind:feature` (#334, open)
- `brain/scripts/governance/checks/issue-link.mjs:23` — accepts `Part of` unconditionally (#340, open)
- `brain/scripts/vcs/substrate.mjs:78-88` — presence probe, not efficacy (#337, open)
- `brain/scripts/vcs/providers/vcs.contract.test.mjs` — the mechanism M10 extends
- `.memory/records/2026-07.jsonl` — 89 duplicate sync_ids (#330-adjacent, unfiled)
- `docs/inbox/seam-contract-coverage-roadmap.md` — merged
- `~/.claude/projects/-home-gandalf-IA-brain/design-docs/seam-contract-coverage-roadmap.md` — local copy, synced
